verdict.comment: A hot renewal that should be run at a strong pace. There are reasons for believing that AFADIL (nap) can bounce back after Aintree.

comments.absurde: High in the weights but every chance with a repeat of his third in the County Hurdle
comments.afadil: Had turned a corner only to then flop at Aintree; the tongue-tie tried there is removed
comments.aurignymill: Came up shy off this career-high mark at Taunton and this is tougher again
comments.daddylonglegs: Ninth in the County Hurdle but he never threatened after losing his place mid-race
comments.hansard: Only 1lb above his last winning mark but hasn't truly threatened this season
comments.knickerbockerglory: Front-runner who wasn't beaten far in the Imperial Cup; this track should suit him
comments.ourchamp: Last year's winner off 13lb lower; good front-running sixth in the County Hurdle
comments.shesasaint: Needs a strong pace at this trip, which she got when winning so well at Aintree; up 9lb
comments.sirgerhard: Not as good as he was but still capable and now running in his first handicap
comments.spiritdaunou: Very solid effort when fifth in the County Hurdle and blinkers are tried this afternoon
comments.tounsivator: Has struggled in handicaps since taking a notable scalp in a Grade 2 in December

verdict.comment: A winning transition to turf beckons for IT'S TIM (nap). Having easily won this race last year, Fiddlers Green is feared most.

comments.angelonhigh: 2-34 score, last win in 2023; seconds and thirds last May-August give him a form chance
comments.fiddlersgreen: Underperforming since last June but won this (good) last year in fine style off same mark
comments.formaladdress: Going down by 1l at Lingfield (1m2f, AW) on penultimate start stands out in his six races
comments.guinnesslad: He's never been beaten less than 10l after nine races but this is his first Flat handicap
comments.harlington: Consistent; needs to improve on his turf form to win this but no way is he dismissed
comments.itstim: Improved second of 11 at Chelmsford (1m2f, AW) last time and that's despite racing wide
comments.khangai: Very busy autumn/winter and basically kept his form well but below form on turf latest
comments.ladypacksapunch: Not the percentage call but sole win was over C&D and close third over C&D 16 days ago
comments.missdubai: Consistent most of last term; more to prove after 212 days off and on softer than good

races.raceComment: khangai is marginally preferred with a score of 46.4%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and more reliable profile over ladypacksapunch. Won 1 of last 6 starts. races.drawBiasExplanation: Longer distance reduces impact of draw position

verdict.comment: Rod Millman has two live chances with Adaay In Devon and Woolhampton but the unexposed 3yo FIRST INSTINCT could be the answer.

comments.adaayindevon: Two Listed wins in 2024, including this race; Friday's rain a plus; good draw; big chance
comments.balmorallady: Made giant strides in the autumn when racing on slow ground; can progress again in 2025
comments.electricstorm: Second to Adaay In Devon in this race last year; solid Group form after; still low mileage
comments.englemere: Three wins at two, including Listed; 3yos have won 3 of the last 9 runnings; can go well
comments.firstinstinct: Didn't stay 7f in Group 3 when last seen; earlier 6f wins most promising; yard in top form
comments.frostatdawn: Group 3 win in Dubai last year; yet to shine in 2025 and wouldn't want significant rain
comments.missattitude: Running well in AW handicaps this year but she has more on her plate at this level
comments.overtheblues: Promise in Ireland last year; new connections won this race with a similar type in 2022
comments.pearlofwindsor: Two wins last year but had her limitations exposed at this level in the autumn
comments.pepsicat: Unlucky not to be placed in this race last year; promise on return 16 days ago; can pull
comments.pureangel: Running well on AW this year but faces another stiff task at Listed level
comments.queenallstar: Won two of her three starts and may do better yet; this a daunting challenge though
comments.runningqueen: Followed Salisbury win last May with two 3rds in Listed company; unexposed; not ruled out
comments.seaemilyrun: Considerable improvement is required dropping to 5f for the first time
comments.sophiasstarlight: Ended 2024 in fine form and shaped okay on her return; only fourth in this race last year
comments.vadream: On losing run of 16 but she's capable at this level and finished 3rd in this race in 2024
comments.woolhampton: Won four handicaps last year and can make her mark at this level granted further progress

races.raceComment: adaayindevon is confidently preferred with a score of 57.7%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form and more progressive over englemere. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 1 wins from 6 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 7/20 at bath. Key attributes include optimal distance and improving, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: With his reappearance behind him, CLOUD KING is given another chance to prove himself well handicapped. Lil Guff is next best.

comments.alexiboy: Promising on AW as a 3yo; gelded/hooded for stable debut; something to prove on turf
comments.cloudking: Bits of form suggest he's a cut above this level; below best on return; cheekpieces now
comments.conniesrose: Condtions no problem and should step forward from this month's seasonal return
comments.kissandrun: Prominent racer; 2nd on this card on last year's return; versatile groundwise; chance
comments.lilguff: C&D winner; handles any ground; mixed record fresh but  booking of Oisin Murphy is a plus
comments.missshowoff: Lightly raced 4yo who drops in grade and can build on her recent C&D return; interesting
comments.phoenixbeach: Arrives in top form but he is up in class and is still seeking a first turf success
comments.sosmart: Infrequent winner but one of his victories came over C&D; fair return but needs more today
comments.tanrapido: Promising return at Southwell and dropped 2lb since; could still have more to offer
comments.thethamesboatman: 8lb lower mark on turf but recent AW efforts short of his best too; others look safer

races.raceComment: conniesrose is marginally preferred with a score of 58.1%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions over sosmart. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 6 wins from 26 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: This can go to the thriving EVA ROSIE who looked value for more the narrow winning margin at Newcastle last time out.

comments.absolutelynot: Minor form since promising debut as 3yo and faded on handicap debut at about 1m; new trip
comments.anificasbeauty: Three AW wins at 6f-7f; lightly raced now; trip query again after fading over 2m latest
comments.anticipating: Maiden; not yet looked like capitalising on a falling mark; has work to do
comments.ayespyed: Had very few chances but never involved on handicap debut over 1m2f; now hooded
comments.evarosie: Not had many chances at this sort of trip; two 1m2f Newcastle wins in 2025; respected
comments.irv: Weighted to win another AW race but below best at the end of 2024; returns from break
comments.kittensdream: Multiple winner at up to 2m but on losing run and doesn't beat many now
comments.limmortale: Did well to win 1m2f Lingfield classified; lacked pace over 1m since; remains of interest
comments.morlaix: On a losing run and off for a year; right down weights and has C&D form; new yard
comments.rampant: Maiden; in good form; similar weights chance to Eva Rosie on 1m2f form; query about 1m3f
comments.sunfestival: Creditable classified runs at up to 1m2f; first 1m3f run for 2 years raises stamina query
comments.sunsetinparis: Five AW wins; solid third in 1m2f classified latest; R Ryan 3-4 on him

races.raceComment: evarosie is marginally preferred with a score of 49.0%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form over sunsetinparis. Won 2 of last 6 starts. verdict.comment: The attractively weighted C&D winner LADY IN HAVANA may prove the answer, having caught the eye on her recent return over 6f here.

comments.albaahy: Has become expensive to follow and a record of 1-38 is hardly inspiring
comments.alsuileile: Has won seven times here including twice on Fibresand, but looks best over 1m; visor on
comments.arcshadowfax: Running with credit lately but still to prove his stamina over this far
comments.aspiretoglory: Has won two of his last three starts; a player from 2lb higher
comments.balmybreese: In the frame in a few 0-50 classified events at Wolverhampton this year, but is 0-27
comments.barneysbay: Inconsistent and has become very hard to win with (3-50)
comments.kingsharja: Finished a neck behind Thanks Dad on is reappearance over C&D; may reverse the form
comments.ladyinhavana: 6lb below last winning mark and caught the eye on her recent return here; respected
comments.rainbowmirage: Has won seven races, including four on the AW, but losing run up to 21
comments.royaljustice: 0-8 and has been well held in three visits here; look elsewhere
comments.rusheenboy: 0-11 since winning twice over 6f here at the end of 2023 and is still 4lb higher
comments.thanksdad: Held off King Sharja when getting off the mark over C&D last time; frame material
comments.tilsworthmax: 0-14 under rules and doesn't look a winner waiting to happen

races.raceComment: ladyinhavana is marginally preferred with a score of 51.4%, holding clear edges in superior course form and more progressive over thanksdad, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: This is especially trappy. Jesse Luc is solid but Mattice and RAMBUSO CREEK may prove better handicapped.

comments.jesseluc: Four wins this year and placed over C&D the last twice; big player with Rossa Ryan booked
comments.madamefenella: Perhaps needed the run when last seen in February; others have more pressing claims
comments.mattice: 0-4 on AW but a repeat of any of those Tapeta runs would give him leading claims
comments.profitstreet: On a dangerous mark but it's been a mixed bag this winter and others look safer
comments.rambusocreek: Yet to fire for current stable but has lots of ability and return of headgear is a plus
comments.sibylcharm: Not built on February's promising 3rd in two runs since; wind surgery since latest; chance
comments.swissace: Should be well treated but he has been underperforming of late; best at 7f too
comments.yoshimi: Three AW wins since October, the latest over C&D; 2lb higher; yard also runs Rambuso Creek

races.raceComment: jesseluc is marginally preferred with a score of 57.1%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and more progressive over yoshimi. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 2 wins from 8 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The most interesting one is SAMBEZI (nap), who had to make up significant ground from the rear to finish third at Fontwell last month.

comments.aquitaineboy: Placed twice over 2m4f since narrow win over that trip in January; a possible
comments.gmsprince: 0-15 over hurdles but has run well here on all three outings this year
comments.greatnessawaits: Two handicap wins this year; also ran well when second in recent seller; in the mix
comments.ikigaistar: Off since falling in December but was a dual 2m hurdle winner last year; a possible
comments.livanobello: Placed in French claimer in September but only minor promise for new stable (three runs)
comments.machosun: Has basement mark on the Flat now and is yet to show any significant hurdling ability
comments.redtrail: Well beaten all three starts for new stable this year; had wind op last month
comments.robbersbridge: Dual winner in early part of season but this stable debut comes after a six-month absence
comments.sambezi: Made big forward move from the rear when placed at Fontwell last month; 1lb lower here
comments.takestime: Has cut little ice in juvenile/maiden hurdles; 7lb wrong for handicap debut
comments.zucayan: Placed all three starts since returning from layoff in February (2m-2m3f); obvious claims

verdict.comment: Dual C&D winner GETAWAY JEWEL returns from a break on a good mark and with the forecast good ground very much in his favour.

comments.fastdeal: Shock 3m3f winner a year ago but that remains his only success after 58 starts
comments.getawayjewel: Off since below-par run in December but is well handicapped and has ideal conditions here
comments.graintrade: Good fourth on handicap hurdle debut but well beaten twice since; chase debut today
comments.jackhammer: Dual hurdle and multiple Flat winner; 0-10 over fences but on a tempting chase mark
comments.pittsburg: In-form 9yo who followed last month's C&D success with emphatic win at Hereford
comments.prospecthouse: Soundly beaten on both starts this year but can fare better now back on good ground
comments.royalmax: Came good over fences with clearcut success at Sedgefield this month; high on the list
comments.vinrouge: Pulled up on sole chase start (in 2023) and arrives here with all sorts to prove
comments.zarasuniverse: Not one to rely upon heavily but was second at Catterick in February and has won over C&D

races.raceComment: pittsburg is marginally preferred with a score of 56.8%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more proven at trip and superior course form over royalmax. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include superior ratings and optimal distance and positive comments, though inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: Fergal O'Brien has won two of the last three runnings of this bumper and NED HILL is entitled to step up on his Wetherby form.

comments.americanempire: Beaten about 8l in bumpers at Lingfield (AW) and Catterick (good to soft)
comments.clickonthelink: Running well at his point of departure in both the Irish points he contested
comments.corrabheinn: First run at Huntingdon was better than the second when ridden by a 10lb claimer
comments.crestofstars: Midfield in a Listed bumper at Cheltenham and that was an encouraging start
comments.exiguus: Finished a remote fourth of seven runners here two months ago when 28-1
comments.nedhill: Stayed on for fourth at Wetherby after finding some trouble in running

races.raceComment: americanempire is marginally preferred with a score of 21.2%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and superior course form and more progressive over crestofstars. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good ground from 1 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include improving, though returning from absence and step up in class and inconsistent profile need consideration.
